page.overview:
Who is Jerry?

Jerry was a welder who worked for Dr. Jack Thorne at Thorne Mobile Field Systems.

When Arby Benton and Kelly Curtis went to Thorne Mobile Field Systems to find Doc Thorne, Doc Thorne yelled at Jerry to "balance the struts on both sides (of the RV trailer)" and told him to remember the crash rests. Thorne further scolded Jerry for "not following the plans" and being "brain dead" to which Jerry apologized. Thorne nevertheless shouted back he didn't need an apology just someone to be correct. Jerry continued to say they were overbuilt while Thorne countered saying he was the designer not Jerry. Jerry wasn't as careful as his fellow worker Henry.
